title: Lake Red Rock Refuse Removal Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > MVD > W07V ENDIST ROCK ISLAND
description:
Solicitation W912EK27QA006 is for Refuse/Recycling Waste Management Services at Lake Red Rock in Knoxville, Iowa. It is issued as a 100% Small Business Set­Aside and will result in a firm fixed price contract with a base and 4 option years. Award will be made to the offeror that can provide the services according to the Performance Work Statement (PWS) within reasonable pricing (lowest priced) deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. Quotes received after the solicitation closing date and time are deemed late and will not be considered for award. Quotes that fail to provide all the required documentation stated in the solicitation will be considered non-responive and will not be considered for award.  

 Attached is the Complete Solicitation with a Solicitation Cover Sheet (W912EK27QA006) with directions on how to submit the solicitation.  Also, a Map of the area is attached (Lake Red Rock Dumpster locations). 

 Please return the solicitation cover sheet along with the prices for the base year and 4 option years. 

 Questions must come directly to Eric Gaul at eric.j.gaul@usace.army.mil.  I will get an answer to you as soon as i can.  Questions will not be answered after Friday, 20 November at 2pm Central.
